replies.author: goldenwalrus909
replies.body: You can open the world to LAN and then select the cheats to be off. Then, you can access all commands and you can select the cheats to be off and get rid of the island. To do this, all you have to do is press 'Esc' and press the open to LAN tab in the middle, between the "Back to Game" and "Disconnect" tabs. Then, select cheats to be on and open the world to LAN. Hope this helps and good luck with the map!

replies.author: goldenwalrus909
replies.body: You could also make a superflat world with the presets of 1x0, I believe. To do this, all you need to do is to make a world, go into "More World Options", select World Type: Superflat, click on "Customize" below that, click on "Presets" and then, in the box at the top of the screen, delete what it says in there and type, without the quotation marks, "1x0".

replies.author: FrostedCupcakez
replies.body:
Frosted's Way Of Getting A Void World Without Plugins

1. Create A New World And Name It Whatever You Wish.. 
2. Change The Gamemode To Creative
3. Go To More World Options And Turn General Structures Off (You Don't Want Floating Villages) 
4. Make World Type To Superflat And Hit Customize 
5. Go To Presets Now Insert In The Bar Above Which Should Say: 2;7,2x3,2;1;village To 2;0;1x0 And Hit Use Preset! (It Should Say Air - Top 1 Most Likely!) Now Hit Done And Create Your New World! 
6. When You Get In Make Sure You Quickly Fly! Or Your Going To Die.. 
7. Go Up Higher ^ Now Type /setblock ~1 ~1 ~1 1 
8. A Stone Block Should Appear! :O Amazing. Now Build In Your New Void Map!
